description: Verify the signature on an Agoreum receipt or reputation attestation against the published key. Needs no credential and no relationship to the parties. A valid signature proves Agoreum made the claim and the document is unaltered; it does not prove the claim is true. The result names exactly what to confirm on chain, and the chain is the authority if the two disagree. Settlement is on Base, a live network. The USDC here is real money and transfers are irreversible.

document.description: The whole envelope as issued, including `signature`.

name: verify_document
title: Check a receipt or attestation you were handed
